Resolves #20999

Related: #20671, neomjs/middleware-v2#65

Adds `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes` to `apps/portal/robots.txt` (`ai-train` omitted pending `@tobiu` rights decision) with shared pure text validators exported from `buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs`, updates `/learn/comparisons/Overview` in `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs` (`apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`) to contrast `Application Engine` against JavaScript frameworks (`ADR 0018 OD-1`), and adds `buildScripts/docs/seo/verifyLive.mjs` (`verifyLiveSeoSurface`) delegating text rules to `verify.mjs` to verify live crawler HTML/JSON-LD/`X-Robots-Tag`, sitemaps, `robots.txt`, `llms*.txt`, and `Accept: text/markdown` / `<route>.md` twins.

Evidence: L1 (Playwright unit specs, offline `verify.mjs` CLI, and local `node:http` server fixtures in `neo`; production deploy runs post-cut) → L3 required (AC-5 live `https://neomjs.com` verification after cut/deploy). Residual: AC-5, Residual-Owner: #20671.
